findings.reason: (promoted to blocking by the orchestrator: a regression the system-r1 fix introduced) `git update-index --add --remove` refuses a path that is a directory on disk ('p/x: is a directory - add individual files instead', rc 128, git 2.38+). A shadow turning file p/x into directory p/x (diff lists p/x deleted, p/x/y added) makes abortMerge fail → ACCEPT_ABORT_FAILED, merge left open; `add -A` handled it. Fix: in abortMerge drop every target that is a directory on disk (lstat isDirectory) — the files inside are already listed in changedPaths. Add a primitives test for the file→directory shadow next to the deleted-path test.
